command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module -Name (Join-Path $PSHOME 'Modules\Microsoft.PowerShell.Security\Microsoft.PowerShell.Security.psd1') -ErrorAction Stop
$versionKey = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion'
$fileSystemKey = Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem'
$policy = @(Get-ExecutionPolicy -List | ForEach-Object {
    [pscustomobject]@{
        Scope = [string]$_.Scope
        ScopeValue = [int]$_.Scope
        ExecutionPolicy = [string]$_.ExecutionPolicy
        ExecutionPolicyValue = [int]$_.ExecutionPolicy
    }
})
[pscustomobject]@{
    captured_utc = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')
    host_version = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()
    host_edition = $PSVersionTable.PSEdition
    policy_module_path = (Get-Module Microsoft.PowerShell.Security).Path
    registry = [pscustomobject]@{
        ProductName = $versionKey.ProductName
        DisplayVersion = $versionKey.DisplayVersion
        CurrentBuild = $versionKey.CurrentBuild
        CurrentBuildNumber = $versionKey.CurrentBuildNumber
        UBR = $versionKey.UBR
    }
    environment_os_version = [Environment]::OSVersion.Version.ToString()
    process_architecture = $env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE
    execution_policies = $policy
    effective_execution_policy = [string](Get-ExecutionPolicy)
    LongPathsEnabled = $fileSystemKey.LongPathsEnabled
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress
